description: Hand-authored plan-1 synthetic truth. Geometry is in the part frame; outward normals. World points are Rz Ry Rx (point+translate_before). Circle radii are circumradii; fn64/fn16 have cardinal vertices. Face IDs describe connected analytic regions, or the aggregate nonanalytic dome region. Parameters lists the expected adjustable treatment/corner/step controls; design includes every top-level SCAD design variable.

parts.ownership_note: Connected coplanar front/back/right faces span both slabs. Their unique provenance owner is slab_1; slab_2 also lists them as support_faces. Base-top corner ledges are separate connected planar regions.
